summary.feedback: This pull request demonstrates good code quality with modern JavaScript practices and proper SQLite integration. The implementation shows attention to error handling and follows reasonable architectural patterns. However, there are opportunities for improvement in test coverage, documentation, and code organization. Key strengths include clean separation of concerns and proper use of OPFS (Origin Private File System) APIs. Areas for enhancement include adding comprehensive unit tests, improving error handling in edge cases, and adding more inline documentation for complex logic.

recommendations: Add comprehensive unit tests for database operations and error scenarios to improve reliability
Implement integration tests for the OPFS SQLite functionality to ensure proper file system operations
Add JSDoc comments to all public methods and complex functions for better code documentation
Consider implementing a connection pooling mechanism if multiple concurrent database operations are expected
Add input validation and sanitization for all user-provided data to prevent SQL injection vulnerabilities
Implement proper logging mechanisms for debugging and monitoring database operations
Consider adding TypeScript definitions or migrating to TypeScript for better type safety
Add error boundary components if this is used in a React application to gracefully handle runtime errors
Implement database migration strategy for schema changes in future versions
Add performance monitoring for database queries to identify potential bottlenecks
